analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI remains at 66.1 in neutral territory, while the MACD histogram has worsened from 87.0208 to -183.7461, indicating a continued downtrend. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.69x the 5-day average, showing a lack of directional momentum. The high ADX of 47.4 suggests strong trend strength, but the MACD deterioration and low volume hint at weakening upward momentum. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see stance until further indicators confirm direction.
